description: Defect B: insertDenial is called on resume before the protected block but its repo dedupe only checks optional externalRef, so a denial WITHOUT externalRef hits its PRIMARY KEY on retry and throws. Make insertDenial idempotent on the denial id. Add needs_more_data and needs_review to the orchestrator RESUMABLE set. Add POST /api/cases/:id/retry to re-run a resumable/held case without duplicate denials/jobs. Add retry + overlapping-work + restart-recovery regression tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (migration runner stable); otherwise independent of C/D/E.
steps: Read server/repositories/caseRepository.ts, server/pipeline/orchestrator.ts, server/routes/caseRoutes.ts, server/jobs/jobRunner.ts and their tests first. context.json covers conventions.

In server/repositories/caseRepository.ts, change insertDenial to upsert on id: keep the existing externalRef early-return dedupe, then use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET (mirroring upsertPatient/upsertClaim) so an existing id is a no-op/update instead of a PRIMARY KEY violation. Preserve the boolean return contract (false when externalRef already present).

In server/pipeline/orchestrator.ts add 'needs_more_data' and 'needs_review' to the RESUMABLE set so a resume resets the case to intake and re-runs deterministically (the resume branch already handles reset + audit 'resume').

In server/routes/caseRoutes.ts add POST /api/cases/:id/retry guarded by requirePermission('run_pipeline'): resolve the case by id (404 if missing), require its state to be resumable/held (failed, needs_more_data, needs_review) else 409, resolve the underlying denial (via ehr.discoverDenials or the stored denial), and re-run the pipeline reusing the denial:<id> idempotency key so no duplicate denial/job rows are created. The orchestrator resume path updates the existing case rather than creating a second one. Keep /api/run/denial/:id and /api/run/poll exactly as-is (they await drain; do NOT convert to async accepted-job APIs).

Add a pipeline/job regression test (in server/pipeline/orchestrator.test.ts or server/jobs/jobRunner.test.ts) that makes getChartDocuments OR reasoning throw exactly once AFTER the case+denial are created (a denial WITHOUT externalRef), then retries and succeeds — proving no PRIMARY KEY violation on the second insertDenial and the case reaches a non-failed state.

Add app tests in server/app.test.ts: run a denial that lands in needs_more_data (e.g. den_003) and POST /api/cases/:id/retry; run/force a case to failed and retry it; after retry assert there is still exactly one denial row and one appeal_case row for that denial (no duplicates).

Add a jobRunner test covering overlapping manual+scheduled work and restart recovery: enqueue a process_denial and a poll job, force one job to status 'running', call recoverInterrupted(), drain(), and assert correct final job/case states and no duplicate cases/jobs.
acceptance_criteria: A denial without externalRef can be inserted twice (retry) without throwing; insertDenial is idempotent on id.
A case in failed / needs_more_data / needs_review can be resumed by the orchestrator and by POST /api/cases/:id/retry.
POST /api/cases/:id/retry requires run_pipeline, returns 404 for missing case and 409 for a non-resumable state, and creates no duplicate denial/case/job rows.
Retry of a previously failed/held case repairs it to a non-failed state deterministically.
recoverInterrupted + drain after a forced 'running' job yields correct final states with no duplicates.
/api/run/denial/:id and /api/run/poll remain synchronous (await drain) and unchanged in contract.
verification: npx vitest run server/repositories server/pipeline server/jobs server/app
findings:
Implemented in server/repositories/caseRepository.ts, server/pipeline/orchestrator.ts, server/routes/caseRoutes.ts + tests.

insertDenial (caseRepository.ts): now idempotent on id via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET (claim_id/source/carrier/carc_codes/rarc_codes/denial_date/raw_text_enc/external_ref), mirroring upsertPatient/upsertClaim. The externalRef early-return dedupe is PRESERVED (still returns false when a row with that external_ref exists; returns true otherwise). A denial WITHOUT externalRef can now be inserted twice (retry) with no PRIMARY KEY violation.

orchestrator RESUMABLE set: added 'needs_more_data' and 'needs_review'. The existing resume branch (cases.updateCase -> 'intake' + audit action 'resume') now fires for these held states, re-running deterministically and updating the existing case (never a second one).

RETRY ROUTE (caseRoutes.ts): POST /api/cases/:id/retry, guarded by requirePermission('run_pipeline'). 404 if case missing; 409 if state not in RETRYABLE = {failed, needs_more_data, needs_review}. Resolves the denial via ehr.discoverDenials() (matching c.denialId) and calls processDenial(services.orchestratorDeps, denial) DIRECTLY. Rationale: direct orchestrator call re-runs/repairs the existing case AND creates zero new job rows (so trivially no duplicate jobs); insertDenial idempotency prevents duplicate denial rows; orchestrator resume prevents duplicate case rows. Returns {caseId, state, packetReady}. NOTE for later FEATs: a PDF-intake denial (not in the synthetic discoverDenials feed, e.g. den_pdf_nodate) is NOT discoverable, so retry returns 409 'no longer discoverable' for those — there is no getDenial repo method yet; if API retry of PDF-sourced cases is needed later, add CaseRepository.getDenial and resolve from storage. /api/run/denial/:id and /api/run/poll left exactly as-is (still await drain, synchronous contract unchanged).

Services.orchestratorDeps was already exposed (services.ts), so no new wiring was needed.

TESTS ADDED (no existing tests weakened/deleted):
- server/pipeline/orchestrator.test.ts: 'retry resumes a failed case without a PRIMARY KEY violation' — denial WITHOUT externalRef (den_noref), flaky EHR whose getChartDocuments throws exactly once AFTER case+denial creation; first processDenial rejects (case 'failed', 1 denial row), retry succeeds to 'packet_ready' with still exactly 1 denial + 1 appeal_case row.
- server/jobs/jobRunner.test.ts: 'overlapping manual + scheduled work with restart recovery yields no duplicates' — manual enqueueProcessDenial(den_001) + poll_denials overlap (poll dedupes den_001 via denial:<id> idempotency key), force manual job 'running', recoverInterrupted() returns 1, drain() -> all jobs 'done', exactly DENIALS.length process_denial jobs + 1 poll, exactly one case per denial.
- server/app.test.ts: new 'POST /api/cases/:id/retry (FEAT-002)' describe: 404 missing case; 409 non-resumable (packet_ready den_001); retry den_003 needs_more_data (200, re-runs to needs_more_data, 1 denial + 1 case row); force case_den_001 to 'failed' via SQL then retry -> 200, repaired to 'packet_ready', 1 denial + 1 case row. Uses testApp()'s returned ctx.db for row-count assertions.

L3 test-verified + L2 static-verified. No real DB touched; synthetic data + local-stub AI only.
